venue.description: Our full-service salon caters to all your beauty needs with expertise in hair, nails, and skincare. Operating seven days a week, we offer a comprehensive range of services designed to pamper and rejuvenate. Understanding the value of your time, we provide the convenience of simultaneous hair and nail appointments, ensuring efficiency without compromising on quality. Embark on your journey to enhanced beauty and self-care by scheduling your appointment with us today.

items.name: Platinum Card
items.caption: 6 hr
items.description:
Client must book for a hair consultation before book this appointment. 
A platinum card in hair coloring is a technique where every single piece of hair is put into a foil and lightened-basically, it's maximum blonding. Instead of doing traditional highlights where you only lighten certain sections, a platinum card covers every strand to lift the hair as evenly and as light as possible. It's often used when someone wants to go super blonde, like platinum, icy, or white blonde shades, especially if they have darker hair to start with. Includes Toner.
